command:
source /usr/lib/openfoam/openfoam2412/etc/bashrc
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
cp -r "$FOAM_TUTORIALS/incompressible/icoFoam/cavity/cavity" /tmp/cavity
cd /tmp/cavity
blockMesh > log.blockMesh 2>&1
icoFoam   > log.icoFoam   2>&1
postProcess -func "fieldMinMax(U,p)" -latestTime > log.postProcess 2>&1 || true
FMM=$(find postProcessing -name fieldMinMax.dat | head -1)
set +e
awk -v fmm="$FMM" '
function chk(label,ok,detail){printf "%-22s %s  [%s]\n",label,detail,(ok?"ok":"FAIL"); if(!ok)fail++}
/^End$/{ended=1}
/continuity errors/{ if(match($0,/cumulative = [-0-9.eE+]+/)){s=substr($0,RSTART+13);cum=s+0} }
/Courant Number/{ if(match($0,/max: [0-9.eE+]+/)){s=substr($0,RSTART+5);cour=s+0} }
END{
  chk("solver_completed", ended==1, "End reached="ended)
  a=(cum<0)?-cum:cum
  chk("mass_continuity", a<1e-6, sprintf("|cumulative|=%.3e want <1e-6",a))
  chk("courant_stable", cour>0 && cour<1.0, sprintf("maxCo=%.4f want 0<Co<1",cour))
  while((getline line < fmm)>0){ if(line !~ /^#/){n=split(line,f,"\t"); for(i=1;i<=n;i++){gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",f[i])} if(f[2]=="mag(U)"){umax=f[5]+0} if(f[2]=="p"){pmin=f[3]+0;pmax=f[5]+0} } }
  chk("lid_bc_respected", umax>0.99 && umax<1.01, sprintf("max|U|=%.5f want ~1.0 (lid)",umax))
  chk("vortex_developed", pmax>1.0 && pmin<-1.0, sprintf("p=[%.3f,%.3f] want span past +/-1",pmin,pmax))
  print (fail==0)?"SMOKE CHECK PASSED":"SMOKE CHECK FAILED ("fail")"
}' log.icoFoam > /tmp/smoke-check.txt
grep -q "SMOKE CHECK PASSED" /tmp/smoke-check.txt; RC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/smoke-check.txt
cp /tmp/cavity/log.icoFoam /tmp/log.icoFoam
tar -cf /tmp/cavity-solution.tar -C /tmp cavity
ls -la /tmp/cavity-solution.tar /tmp/log.icoFoam /tmp/smoke-check.txt
[ $RC -eq 0 ] || { echo "smoke check did not pass"; exit 1; }
echo "TASK OK"
